ratchet.note: Ratchet (UMAIR item 4, 2026-11-19): the gate FAILS when the count of direct renderer fetches of unmigrated CLOUD routes exceeds this baseline (it was 39, then 47, then 44 — it must never grow again). The count may only go down. The same commit that migrates routes (sets migrated: true) MUST lower the baseline to the new count; never raise it. Slice 2 (2026-11-20): 44 -> 32 (staff login 1 + staff/me 11 direct fetches moved to the cloud-endpoint helper). Slice 4 (2026-11-20): 32 -> 31 (createPurchase in src/lib/purchases/client.ts moved to the cloud-endpoint helper; the purchase-sync submit was never counted — fetchImpl( does not match the gate scanner). Slice 6 (2026-11-20): 31 -> 9 (ai-business-query 4 + ai/customers 3 + ai/purchases 1 + ai/sales 1 + ai/suppliers 3 + books/convert 1 + fx/rates 2 + location/device-session 5 + location/upload 2 direct fetches moved to the cloud-endpoint helper; location/current had no counted direct fetch — its call used a template literal, which the gate scanner misses — but it was migrated too). Employees S scope: 9 -> 8 after staff invite moved. Unmigrated callers of newly classified routes have their own per-file caps; /api/customers POST remains local.
